title: Grouch (Joker Parody)
text: Damn, that smells straight like ass, man. No, no, no. I kind of like it. Yeah? You like trash so much, why don't you live in it? Why don't you fight me? Damn, Oscar, why are you such a grouch, man? From the studio that brought you Joker and the twisted minds at Sesame Workshop comes the next gritty anti-hero origin story. Why do you think you're always in such a bad mood? Are things getting worse out there? The friendly neighborhood of Sesame Street has now become a haven of crime and corruption. I'm Guy Smiley, ABC, DEFG News. Cookers and pimps on every corner. Now look, Prairie Dawn, you want to snuff these hoes, okay? And snuff these hoes early. I'm sorry, Daddy. Bitch, you better shut your damn mouth for good. People getting killed over nothing. Give me the ducky. Penny, give it to him. Hell no, bitch. And how does that make you feel? Calls you trash. Everyone treats you like trash. Why don't you just become trash? Variety asks, did we need a dark take on Oscar the Grouch? No, says the New York Times. The beloved residents of Sesame Street look like you've never seen them before. You want to see this big bird dance? Why? Ooh, three, three pairs for me. From director Todd Phillips. Sweepin' the clouds away. And the writer of P is for potty. On my way where the air is sweet. Can you tell me how to get... Yes! Would you do me one favor? Would you call me the Grouch? Brought to you by the letter R. Scram!
